Distinguish primary evidence, prediction, association and experimental validation; preserve provenance and negative findings. Preregistrations are immutable. There is no wet lab: make no EMC efficacy, safety, selectivity or clinical-readiness claim. Absence of a located source is NOT evidence a claim is false — say NO SOURCE LOCATED and stop there. An approximation marker matters: report a rounded value against a more precise source as a precision refinement, not a numeric error. Your verdict is specific to THIS paper. Do not generalise to the repository and do not run a broad census.

   575	methodology papers and single-trial precedents. Family D is the only one that attacks the
   576	natural-history confound rather than relocating it, and it has the least formal endorsement behind
   577	it.
   578	
   579	Family A transfers immediately and costs no patients, but inherits the confound whole; it changes
   580	which number is uncalibrated. Family B transfers only where an agent produces a specific
   581	non-shrinkage change that imaging detects. Family C improves reporting cheaply without addressing
   582	small samples.
   583	
   584	---
   585	
   586	## 8. Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma, a worked extreme
   587	
   588	Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma is a translocation sarcoma, and one of the rarest diseases for
   589	which any prospective trial record exists. Over the 47 patients ever evaluated for response inside a prospective trial with
   590	protocol-defined assessment, objective response was 12.8% (6 of 47, Wilson 95% CI 6.0 to 25.2) and
   591	disease control 89.4% (42 of 47, 77.4 to 95.4), a gap of 76.6 percentage points composed entirely of
   592	36 patients with stable disease. Those figures and their sources are owned by the companion analysis
   593	([`emc-endpoint-discordance.json`](./emc-endpoint-discordance.json)) and are not re-derived here.
   594	
   595	Placed against the 552 arms above, 76.6 points falls at the 88.9th percentile. The disease sits in
   596	the upper tail of a distribution rather than outside it, and that is a weaker claim about this
   597	tumour than a single-disease reading would support, together with a stronger claim about endpoints.
   598	
   599	On the map, a 12.8% response rate requires 17 patients for a 90% chance of observing one response,
   600	and 79 for an exact single-stage design against a 5% null. The two modern prospective cohorts
   601	accrued 22 and 23 response-evaluable patients, over three and four years respectively. The disease
   602	cannot accrue the trial its own response rate requires, which is the condition section 3.2 counts
   603	across between 31.8% and 73.9% of the conditions where that comparison is defined.
   604	
   605	Both cohorts completed and both are counted from their published reports rather than from registry
   606	postings, so this coordinate is not drawn from either accrual population and the mixture described
   607	in section 3.4 does not reach it. The worked example is in that narrow sense the cleanest point on
   608	the map, which is an accident of it being the one disease read from primary sources.
   609	
   610	---
   611	
   612	## 9. Limitations
   613	
   614	**The corpus is not a random sample.** Only arms posting a complete four-cell table appear, 552 among
   615	the arms of 4,414 screened studies. Section 5 bounds the size of what is missing and states the bias
   616	argument in both directions without settling it.
   617	
   618	**Condition strings are registry strings, and they bias the map.** One disease may appear under
   619	several spellings and a broad string may absorb several diseases. The broad strings collect
   620	dose-escalation arms and sit disproportionately at the bottom of the response axis, so the
   621	coarsening is directional and points toward this paper's own conclusion. Section 3.3 measures that
   622	difference and shows the finding survives a restriction to phase 2 and phase 3 arms, which is the
   623	reason the sensitivity is reported rather than the reason it was run.
   624	
   625	**A coordinate is two medians.** Trials within a condition vary widely, and a median coordinate
   626	summarises a heterogeneous set rather than describing any particular trial.
   627	
   628	**Accrual records achievement, not capacity.** Actual enrolment reflects eligibility, funding and
   629	competing trials, not what a disease could accrue under a better design.
   630	
   631	**Response criterion and review status are absent.** Posted results do not carry the criterion
   632	version, the imaging interval, or whether assessment was by investigator or blinded central review.
   633	Disease-control rates from different imaging schedules are not the same measurement, and this
   634	analysis cannot separate them.
   635	
   636	**The remedy audit is not a systematic review.** It reports what a frozen query set returned. A
   637	disease absent from section 7 may have an endorsed alternative these queries did not reach, and a
   638	disease present in it is usually there on the strength of one document. Fix family, domain and
   639	endorsement grade are judgements read from retrieved records, and a reader may dispute a
   640	classification without disturbing a citation. The count of covered domains is therefore a floor on
   641	what exists and a poor estimate of it.
   642	
   643	**No causal claim.** Nothing here shows that a different endpoint would have produced a better
   644	treatment decision in any trial.
   645	
   646	---
   647	
   648	## 10. Implications for trial reporting
   649	
   650	Three consequences follow, none requiring agreement about which endpoint is correct.
   651	
   652	1. **Publication of the four-cell table.** Complete response, partial response, stable disease and
   653	   progression, with the denominator that produced them. This costs one table, is compatible with
   654	   every endpoint a later reader might want, and is absent from 95.2% of the trials that name best
   655	   overall response in their own registry text. It is the single change with the largest effect on
   656	   what the published record can answer.
   657	2. **A stated response-evaluable denominator.** Intention-to-treat, response-evaluable and
   658	   at-least-one-post-baseline-scan are three different denominators, and a rate attached to the wrong
   659	   one misstates both the estimate and the evidence base.
   660	3. **A sourced null.** A single-arm trial reporting a threshold without stating where the threshold
   661	   came from cannot be argued with. A null attributed to a published figure can be.

   663	For a disease whose coordinate places it below the design boundary, section 7 supplies the menu of
   664	remedies already endorsed elsewhere, and section 6 identifies what would be needed to calibrate the

## Limitations

I found it only because I recomputed from the row data. There may be further hand-written strings in these producers that I did not recompute; I recomputed three (phase composition, the phase-2/3 restriction, the accrual medians) and one of the three was wrong.
- **I did not execute any producer, test, figure generator or `preflight.sh`**, so no claim here is backed by a run. Everything is source reading plus arithmetic over committed JSON. The proposed replacements are `PROPOSED (NOT RUN)` — none has been applied, and no guard has been observed green or red after them.
- **Reference-list correctness was out of scope.** I checked that §7's counts match the audit artifact, not that the 21 references resolve to real papers; `test_every_citation_marker_resolves_and_every_reference_is_cited` exists for that and I did not run it.
- **Figure SVG contents were not read**, only the captions against `R8`/`G3` leaves. If a figure disagrees with its caption, this review would not see it.
- **§2.1's "Two query families were frozen"** describes only the arm queries; §3.4 later introduces two further frozen accrual queries. Not a numeric defect, and I propose no change, but a reviewer counting frozen queries will get 2 from §2 and 4 from the provenance block.
- **The word-count headroom on the abstract is 2 words by my count** (303 against the 305 limit), computed my own way after stripping the bold section labels; the test may count marginally differently. D1 is word-neutral, so it is safe either way — but no other abstract edit is.
- **Absence of a located source is not evidence a claim is false.** Every quantity resolved, so this caveat did not have to be invoked.
